en_title: Dead Cells Developer Motion Twin Responds after Guillermo del Toro Begs for Version Without Respawns
cn_title: 《死亡细胞》回应德尔·托罗无重生请求
subtitle: 可立刻帮上忙
opus_summary: 吉尔莫·德尔·托罗称《死亡细胞》有趣，却希望开发商Motion Twin为年长玩家提供无重生版本。Motion Twin回应称，游戏的辅助模式已可让玩家从当前生物群系起点或最近检查点复活。

paragraphs.en: Dead Cells developer Motion Twin has responded to acclaimed filmmaker Guillermo del Toro’s thoughts on the game — specifically, his request for a mode without respawns.
paragraphs.cn: 《死亡细胞》开发商Motion Twin回应了知名电影人吉尔莫·德尔·托罗对这款游戏的看法，具体来说，是他希望加入无重生模式的请求。

paragraphs.en: Dead Cells is one of the better known roguelite games out there. Released in 2018, it helped popularize the roguelite-metrovania genre and continues to see support from Motion Twin, receiving consistent updates, crossovers, and content years later.
paragraphs.cn: 《死亡细胞》是较为知名的Roguelite游戏之一。它于2018年发售，助推了Roguelite-银河城这一类型的普及；多年后，Motion Twin仍持续为其提供支持，稳定推出更新、联动及新内容。

paragraphs.en: It’s also a critically-acclaimed title, with IGN giving it a 9.5 out of 10. It’s so well-loved that even Pan’s Labyrinth creator Guillermo del Toro can’t get enough of it… though he did have some requests for its developer.
paragraphs.cn: 这也是一款备受好评的作品，IGN曾为它打出9.5分（满分10分）。它广受喜爱，连《潘神的迷宫》创作者吉尔莫·德尔·托罗也玩不够……不过他对开发商也提出了一些请求。

paragraphs.en: Speaking with IGN as part of our IGN30 Icon Series, del Toro spoke about how “interesting” the game is to him, but urged Motion Twin to make a version without respawning.“I just hate respawning, because you only get about 35 levels and then you start again. You get faster, but please, do a version without respawning for the older, for the elderly players. I’m available. Contact me and send it to me, please. I beg you!” he joked.
paragraphs.cn: 德尔·托罗在IGN30传奇人物系列访谈中称，这款游戏对他来说很「有趣」，但他敦促Motion Twin推出无重生版本。他开玩笑说：「我就是讨厌重生，因为你只能打大约35关，然后又得从头开始。你会变快，但拜托，为年纪较大、年长的玩家做一个无重生版本吧。我随时有空。请联系我，把它发给我，求你们了！」

paragraphs.en: Well, Motion Twin has answered. In a statement shared with IGN, the Dead Cells developer thanked the filmmaker for his high praise and informed him of the game’s Assist Mode, which allows players to tweak certain settings to make their runs a bit easier.
paragraphs.cn: Motion Twin作出了回应。这家《死亡细胞》开发商在向IGN分享的声明中感谢了这位电影人的高度赞誉，并向他介绍了游戏的辅助模式；玩家可调整部分设置，让每次冒险轻松一些。

paragraphs.en: "We'd like to officially add this moment into our own personal Cabinet of Curiosities,” Motion Twin said.
paragraphs.cn: Motion Twin表示：「我们想正式把这一刻收进我们自己的珍奇柜。」

paragraphs.en: "We are surprised and truly honored to see that Mr. del Toro is a Dead Cells player, and we can even help him right now: there is an Assist mode in the game! This mode lets you resurrect at the start of the current biome or closest checkpoint, rather than restarting the entire run.
paragraphs.cn: 「得知德尔·托罗先生是《死亡细胞》玩家，我们既惊讶又深感荣幸，而且我们现在就能帮到他：游戏里有辅助模式！该模式可让你在当前生物群系的起点或最近检查点复活，而不是重新开始整趟冒险。

paragraphs.en: "Thank you very much Guillermo for your kind words and your time on the game. We hope this little message will help you!”
paragraphs.cn: 非常感谢吉尔莫·德尔·托罗的美言，以及你花在游戏上的时间。希望这段小小的留言能帮到你！」

paragraphs.en: Introduced in version 2.9, Dead Cells’ Assist Mode lets players customize settings to their liking, allowing them to resurrect from their last save point rather than restarting an entire run. Additionally, players can choose to make traps activate more slowly, lengthen the time of parry windows, engage an auto-hit mode (which does exactly what you think it does), and much more.
paragraphs.cn: 《死亡细胞》的辅助模式在2.9版引入，玩家可按喜好自定义设置，从上一个存档点复活，而不必重开整趟冒险。此外，玩家还可选择让陷阱更慢触发、延长招架判定窗口、启用自动攻击模式（作用正如你所想），以及进行更多调整。

paragraphs.en: Our conversation with Guillermo del Toro is just a small snippet of our full IGN30 Icon Series interview, which drops later this year. In the meantime, you can check out our previous Icon Series chat with Ken Levine, creator of famed games like System Shock 2 and its spiritual successor, Bioshock.
paragraphs.cn: 我们与吉尔莫·德尔·托罗的对话只是完整IGN30传奇人物系列访谈的一小段，完整访谈将于今年晚些时候发布。与此同时，你可以看看我们此前与肯·列文的传奇人物系列对谈；他创作过《网络奇兵2》及其精神续作《生化奇兵》等知名游戏。
